therapeutic_hypothesis.compound: Allogeneic CD56-positive CD3-negative Natural Killer Cells
therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: NK cell-mediated cytotoxicity against leukemic cells
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Enhanced graft-versus-leukemia effect through donor NK cell infusion
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with high risk myeloid malignancies undergoing allogeneic stem cell transplant
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Dose-limiting toxicities of NK cell infusion

results.effect_size: DLT rates varied by donor type and dose level, with highest rates in cord blood NK cell groups
subgroup_findings: Group A (KIR mismatched haplo donors): Lower DLT rates at higher doses
Group B (KIR mismatched cord blood donors): Higher DLT rates, especially at highest dose level
Group C (matched related donors): Intermediate DLT rates
safety_signals: Graft-versus-host disease (GI, liver, chronic skin, chronic lung)
results.dose_information: NK cell doses: 10^6, 10^7, 3x10^7, 10^8 cells, given with aldesleukin support

context.comparator: Dose escalation study without control arm
